Xander de Vries 87 once spearheaded a project for a retail client where we needed to predict customer churn. The challenge was balancing model accuracy with computational constraints. He designed a feature engineering pipeline that reduced training time by 35% while maintaining 91% precision. His iterative approach—testing hypotheses on feature interactions, then refining thresholds based on validation metrics—allowed us to deploy a solution that increased retention by 22% within six months. Colleagues from analytics and operations praised his ability to bridge technical rigor with business needs.  

Xander is a Senior Data Science Consultant at Strata Consulting Group, where he leads high-stakes projects requiring both technical depth and strategic vision. He thrives in ambiguity, often redefining problems before diving into solutions. His mentorship of junior consultants is notable: he pairs them with real-world datasets, emphasizing the importance of ethical data practices and transparency in model deployment.  

His strengths lie in structuring complex problems into tractable components and building models that scale across teams. For example, he recently redesigned a client’s statistical forecasting framework, integrating external economic indicators to improve accuracy by 18% over baseline methods. His work demands precision, but he balances this with a collaborative spirit that fosters innovation.  

Xander is a reliable, intellectually curious professional whose contributions elevate both his team and the organizations he serves. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any opportunity where analytical excellence and leadership are priorities.
